newsitem.title: USA: LIFE MEDICAL GETS FAT TRANSPLANT PATENT.
newsitem.headline: LIFE MEDICAL GETS FAT TRANSPLANT PATENT.

text.p: Life Medical Sciences Inc said Tuesday that it has been granted a U.S. patent on the company's technology for improving the success rates of transplantation of the patient's own body fat during cosmetic and reconstructive plastic surgery.

According to Life Medical, cosmetic surgeons have reported that the use of the patient's own fat cells in filling tissue deficits and tissue augmentation has distinct clinical benefits compared with the use of foreign substances, such as bovine collagen or silicon.

The first product in development based on this proprietary technology is LIPOEL, which Life Medical said has demonstrated encouraging results in pilot clinical evaluations in enhancing the long-term survival of transplanted autologous (patient's own) fat cells during facial plastic surgery.
